scope: Source/report publication screening, CPU validation and authorized report-output safety repair; no GPU/game/Git stage/ref mutation

reset.contract: Raw Pre/Post/Core disable history if either History or MV resource is absent; public mv=None supplies a real zero tensor; reset Graph ignores MV and rejects contradictory History presence
reset.review: Checked resource predicates, public/raw distinction, matching fused post arithmetic in net/export, fixed Graph resource contract, coverage and report safety. The later six-column half normalization is independently reviewed in batch4_rounding_review.json and current model acceptance is recorded separately below.
reset.gpu_scope: Parent owns final GPU Reset suite; this audit does not substitute CPU methods for it

sampling.review: Checked full 16+9+20+Graph coverage, partial reports, unknown-CLI stale PASS invalidation, report aliases, authored RCP driver signatures/context cache/current stream/Graph warmup/error propagation and inference-only API
sampling.gpu_scope: Sampler worker owns numerical GPU comparisons; empirical RTX3060 filtering is not native sm120 parity

snapshot_policy: Own source snapshots under schedule_capture/sources are included. Original binaries, PTX/cubin/weights/images and third-party SDKs remain ignored. Historical failure JSON is retained.
inventory_scope: All tracked dirty and untracked nonignored regular files; this self-referencing report is in stage list but excluded from inventory SHA
unique_cpu_method_count_policy: Historical pre-rounding cohort only: initial 77 distinct methods plus shared safety 13 plus then-current Torch discover 31. Sampling 12, temporal 4 and schedule 21 repeats are not added. Current rounded CPU 35 is a separate cohort with overlapping methods and is NOT added to 121.
publication_limits: A point-in-time inventory; parent must recheck later changes before staging
Automated credential and raw-payload screening is not a third-party legal audit
No Git stage/index/ref mutation, GPU execution or real game access performed
git_index_observation: Raw index identity can change during other workers' Git status/refresh/staging. Audit invokes no stage/ref mutation and disables optional Git locks on final inventory reads; staged paths are observed separately.

historical_pre_rounding_verification.policy: Immutable previous cohort; original logs and source identity are retained. This is not current-model acceptance.

gpu.reference_identity_policy: Installed model SHA below is metadata, not the identity of every reference. Reset uses retained f454 capture; schedule/motion use retained d442 captures; controls/postprocess use legacy d442 harness/rt_sm86; resolutions use legacy hashed PPMs. Each child report records its actual runtime/reference identity.

latest_model_verification.count_policy: 35 current CPU methods overlap the historical 121; no sum or new unique-method claim is made. GPU suites are counted separately.
latest_model_verification.execution_policy: Root executed the new CPU/GPU suites. This refresh only reads their reports/logs and verifies identities; it does not execute GPU work.
